question: Including Anni 12 persons, had gone to restaurants in which, every 11 persons spends 64 rupees on food 12th person spends 66 more rupees than average of all 12 persons then find the total expense on food.
solution:
**Given:**

12 persons had gone to restaurants.

11 out of 12 spend 64 rupees on food each.

12th person spends Rs. 66 rupees more than the average of all persons

**Formula used:**

Total weight = Average weight × Number of boxes

Calculation:

Let the average expenditure be X

As 11 persons each spend 64 rupees and the 12th spends X + 66

⇒ (11× 64 + X + 66) / 12 = X

⇒ 11 × 64 + X + 66 = 12X

⇒ 11X = 11 × 64 + 66, X = 64 + 6, X = 70

**∴ Total expanse is 12 × 70 = 840**
